description: Stacked backdrop-filter layers, each masked to its own band, so a blur ramps across an edge instead of switching on. It is decorative (aria-hidden) and takes no pointer events. Preview until its stable evidence is recorded.

positions.description: Where the blur sits: along the bottom edge, along the top edge, or across the whole box (`both`, which fades in at the top and out at the bottom and ignores the height).
